The feedback loop breaks because: proof required but no proof input shown, duplicate submissions create two feedback records, stale state version causes silent rejection, and the dashboard does not refresh after submission. This document prevents every one of these.
⚖ LAW: A task does not become real execution until feedback is submitted through the FeedbackProcessingEngine. The frontend NEVER marks a task complete locally.
⚖ LAW: Every feedback submission MUST include expectedStateVersion AND idempotencyKey. Without these, concurrent submissions corrupt state.
